mentions.name: Pokehike (Pokemon Crystal port for ESP32)
mentions.description: A Rust port of Pokemon Crystal for a specific ESP32 dev board with a round AMOLED screen, started as a Pokemon-themed tamagotchi clone with step counting to motivate walking and grown into a full port of the whole game. It has a redesigned UI for round screens with touch controls, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi trading, autosave, contextual action buttons, and an experimental auto play mode that advances the game while you walk in real life, keeps a log of interesting events, and lets you take over at any time.
mentions.problem: The author wanted motivation to walk more, using step counting in a Pokemon-themed tamagotchi clone.
mentions.source_excerpt: The goal was to have a basic pokemon themed tamagotchi clone with step counting that motivated me to walk more. It snowballed into a full fledged rust port of the whole game, with a completely redesigned UI meant for round screens and touch controls. It's got bluetooth and wifi trading, autosave, contextual action buttons, etc.
